name: Token Monitor
author: shuuul
description: Amp, Codex, Kimi Code, Cursor, Grok, Notion AI, Zed, and Droid quotas in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: One bar meter and one panel: session, weekly, credits, and pace for the supported providers.

schema.label: Browser cookies
schema.description: Read session cookies from this Chromium-based browser.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the panel polls every provider. Default 5 minutes.

schema.label: Refresh on open
schema.description: When on, opening the panel fetches every provider. Default off.

schema.label: Show remaining
schema.description: When on, meters show leftover quota. When off, they show used.

schema.label: Hide email
schema.description: When on, the panel does not show the account email.
